title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: In the Jade Slip left by Mo Xiansheng, faint traces of his father Chen Xuan's research notes on the secret realm's map emerged—those marked locations coincidentally overlapped by seventy percent with the Tianji visions Chen Ji had witnessed.

text.content:
The crowd surged like a tide, disciples from various sects arguing over secret realm名额 with flushed faces. Chen Ji leaned against the shadows in the corner, his gaze sharp as a hawk锁定ing that familiar figure at the edge of the crowd—Ye Qing. She wore a plain white dress today, standing out among the Demonic Path disciples in their black robes, her expression carrying a trace of undetectable anxiety.

A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. This Demonic Path Saint was quite bold, actually appearing on righteous sect territory. However, her deliberate presence within his line of sight clearly meant she had something to say.

dialogue.content:
"Young Master Chen, might we speak privately?"

Ye Qing's voice sounded beside Chen Ji's ear, cold yet tinged with urgency. Her gaze swept the surroundings as she lowered her voice: "Something has happened within the Holy Sect. I need your help."

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer immediately. Instead, he leisurely drew a jade talisman from his sleeve and silently activated it. An invisible barrier enveloped the two of them, blocking others' prying eyes.

"Lady Ye, what refined taste you have—meeting a Demonic Path member on righteous sect grounds. If our Tianqing Sect patrol brothers were to spot you, you might gain quite the reputation for 'entering the tiger's den.'" He gazed at her with an amused expression, but beneath lay cold calculation.

dialogue.content:
"I have no time for word games."

Ye Qing bit her lower lip, a rare vulnerability flickering in her eyes: "Xuanmingzi, the Holy Sect's Third Elder, has defected. He brought over a thousand core disciples to the Youming Sect and is now hunting me. My Demonic Path mist can only sustain for three days—Chen Ji, I need your Tianji Record."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing extended an olive branch of cooperation, and Chen Ji must decide how to handle this sudden turn of events.

choices.description: No need to rush a response—let Ye Qing reveal all her cards before deciding. Information is power.
choices.risk_hint: Might be delayed by the other party, losing initiative

text.content: Chen Ji nodded slightly, gesturing for her to continue. Ye Qing took a deep breath and began recounting the Holy Sect's internal upheaval—Xuanmingzi had gained partial control over the Ancient Forbidden Land, and a bloodstorm was about to engulf both righteous and evil paths.

choices.description: There's no free lunch in this world. First reveal what you can offer in exchange for her intelligence—this has always been Chen Ji's style.
choices.visible_reward: Tianji Record divines one key piece of information

dialogue.content: Ye Qing paused slightly, then revealed a wry smile: "You're exactly as the rumors describe—calculating every detail. Very well, I agree."

text.content:
Just as Ye Qing was about to continue, Chen Ji's gaze suddenly sharpened—across the crowd, a sharp sword intent was approaching this direction.

Su Qingyao.

Dressed in snow-white, her sword unsheathed three inches, sword intent fierce, she had directly driven back several loose cultivators who tried to approach. Her electric gaze shot directly toward Chen Ji and Ye Qing.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji, what are you doing here?"

Su Qingyao's voice was cold as ice, advancing step by step. Her gaze lingered on Ye Qing for a moment, her brow furrowing: "Demonic Path Saint?"

text.content:
Chen Ji sighed inwardly—this Inner Sect Senior Fellow arriving at just the right moment. Just as he was about to explain, Ye Qing suddenly stepped forward, blocking in front of him.

"Senior Su has misunderstood." Ye Qing's voice regained the composure befitting a Demonic Path Saint. "I was merely passing through. Seeing this Tianqing Sect Outer Disciple/Servant alone, I wished to strike up conversation—after all, someone who survived the secret realm qualification fight must have some extraordinary abilities."

dialogue.content:
Hmph, quite the conversation.

Su Qingyao coldly laughed, her sword fully drawn. In an instant, powerful sword intent pressed down on everyone present like something tangible—Foundation Building late stage cultivation, yet combat power approaching Golden Core!

"How dare a Demonic Path member cause trouble on Tianqing Sect grounds?"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's sword intent笼罩ed the entire area, and Chen Ji must make a choice under everyone's watchful eyes—his relationship with Ye Qing was about to be exposed.

choices.description: Act the part of atrash Outer Disciple/Servant, pretend to be threatened by Ye Qing, let Su Qingyao "save" you—continue maintaining the persona.
choices.risk_hint: Might put Ye Qing in danger

text.content: Chen Ji immediately assumed a terrified expression. "S-Senior Su, save me! This Demonic Path witch suddenly appeared. I-I don't know what she wants—" His voice trembled slightly, the performance utterly convincing.

choices.description: Stop pretending, directly stand before Ye Qing, demonstrate ally stance—but this will arouse Su Qingyao's suspicion.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly stepped forward, positioning himself directly before Ye Qing. His gaze was no longer cowardly but an unfathomable darkness: "Senior Su, she is my guest."

text.content:
Su Qingyao's sword intent faltered slightly. She stared into Chen Ji's eyes as if trying to excavate every secret from those dark pupils.

After a moment, she sheathed her sword and said coldly: "The secret realm qualification fight approaches. I hope you remember your position." She turned to leave but added quietly after several steps: "Tonight at the Hour of Rat, I'll find you."

dialogue.content:
She's gone...

Ye Qing exhaled deeply, her gaze toward Chen Ji growing more complex: "Just now, why did you stand in front of me? You could have stayed out of it—"

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer her question, merely saying calmly: "Su Qingyao is no fool. Our contact won't stay hidden from her for long. Rather than explain afterward, it's better to lay our cards on the table now— she'd find out eventually anyway."

Just as the words fell, a phantom shadow slowly emerged from the jade talisman in Chen Ji's sleeve.

dialogue.content:
Hmph, you臭小子, you're getting better at leveraging situations.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul appeared faintly in the moonlight. He stroked his non-existent beard, his gaze falling on Ye Qing: "Demonic Path Saint... interesting. That seal on your body—that's a variable."

Who are you?!

Ye Qing instinctively stepped back, Demonic Path mist churning around her, yet frozen still by a single look from Mo Xiansheng.

Who I am doesn't matter. What matters is—

Mo Xiansheng turned to Chen Ji, the playfulness in his expression fading, replaced by unprecedented solemnity: "Boy, the things your father left behind—I've found them."

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart lurched.

His father Chen Xuan's legacy—that was the sole thing he had pursued during his tenure as a Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple. For ten years, he had secretly searched the entire Tianqing Sect's scripture hall, secret realm dungeons, even the former Sect Master Ling Yuan's private forbidden grounds, yet found nothing.

And now, Mo Xiansheng was telling him they were found?

dialogue.content:
While you were all debating secret realm qualifications, the Tianji Record reacted on its own.

Mo Xiansheng waved his hand, and a yellowed Jade Slip materialized before Chen Ji. Complex formation patterns carved its surface, emanating a faint familiar aura—the aura of his father.

"This contains your father's research on the secret realm map." Mo Xiansheng's tone was profound. "And I can tell you—the secret realm's true entrance and the location shown by the Tianji Record... seventy percent overlap."

text.content:
Chen Ji extended his trembling hand and received the Jade Slip. The slip was warm to the touch, as if still retaining his father's warmth. His mind involuntarily conjured that blurry figure—Chen Xuan, that legendary figure chosen by the Tianji Record, who ultimately fell.

"Father..." he murmured.

Ye Qing and Mo Xiansheng exchanged glances and tactfully remained silent. Some secrets don't need outsiders present.

choice.prompt: The Jade Slip contained his father's legacy and the secret realm's truth. Chen Ji needed to stay calm amid excitement— was this Jade Slip's appearance coincidence or someone's deliberate arrangement?

choices.description: Father's legacy can't be delayed. First clarify what's recorded in the Jade Slip.
choices.risk_hint: Might fall into the other party's trap

text.content: Chen Ji probed the Jade Slip with his spiritual sense, and a complex map unfurled in his mind. Secret realm entrance, dangerous zones, hidden opportunities— his father's annotations were detailed enough to startle, as if he had foreseen today's chaos long ago.

choices.description: The timing of the Jade Slip's appearance is too coincidental. Must first understand Mo Xiansheng's intentions—why did father's legacy only appear now?
choices.visible_reward: Gain Mo Xiansheng's trust, understand more truth
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng might be hiding something

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng nodded approvingly: "Good question. This Jade Slip appears now because the Tianji Record sensed the secret realm's imminent opening—your father's contingency left behind years ago is resonating with today's changes."

text.content:
Chen Ji tucked the Jade Slip into his sleeve, his gaze profound.

Tonight was destined to be eventful—Demonic Path Saint seeking aid, Su Qingyao requesting a late-night meeting, father's legacy suddenly appearing... all clues pointed in the same direction: the secret realm.

"Ye Qing." he suddenly spoke.

"Hmm?"

"Xuanmingzi's pursuit—I can help you withstand it. But as exchange—" Chen Ji turned,直视 her eyes, "I want you to tell me what the Holy Sect has prepared for this secret realm's opening."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing remained silent for a moment, then finally nodded.

"Very well. The Holy Sect has dispatched three Transformed God stage Elders this time, targeting the 'Heavenly Dao Fragment' at the secret realm's core—supposedly a fragment of the Dao Fruit left behind by an ancient great one, enough to birth a new Tribulation Transcendence stage expert for a sect."

Her voice dropped extremely low: "And the true reason for Xuanmingzi's defection—he discovered the Holy Sect planned to use my life as a sacrifice. I am their prepared 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.'"

text.content:
Heavenly Fate Lock Key—these words exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder.

He thought of his sister Chen Nian, that girl taken by the Holy Sect years ago, still missing to this day. What took her away was the exact same reason.

Ye Qing... and Chen Nian, share the same fate?

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly, seemingly sensing Chen Ji's emotional fluctuations, yet saying nothing.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his churning emotions.

"Heavenly Fate Lock Key..." he repeated the term, a sharp light flickering in his eyes. "Interesting. The Holy Sect's calculations are indeed clever. Unfortunately, they've overlooked one thing."

Ye Qing slightly startled: "What?"

Chen Ji did not answer, only raising his head to gaze at the night sky. The bright moon hung high, its clear radiance like frost, casting a deep shadow over his tranquil features.

"They don't know that you've already found an ally."
